name: Veyra Spatial, Compound and Common-Mode Reliability Specialist

invariants.non_causal_propagation: Models empirical spatio-temporal error covariance across the 25-station network, never physical causality.
invariants.anti_leakage: All evaluation features strictly constrained to issue time t0. Station ground truth sealed behind 24h verification latency.
invariants.no_probability_averaging: Compound hazards evaluated via joint copula sets with explicit Fréchet-Hoeffding bounds, never averaged.
invariants.rainfall_distinct_from_flood: Precipitation forecast failure reliability is strictly distinct from hydrological flood probability.
invariants.unseen_region_generalization: Leave-one-region-out (LORO) hold-out validation required for all spatial models.
